_comment: Xiangyin 98 Help (/help). Each topic has an id (its #anchor), a title, an icon, index keywords and HTML, in English and Chinese (titleZh, keywordsZh, htmlZh). {email} and {instagram} are filled in from site.json.

topics.title: Welcome to Xiangyin 98
topics.html:
This is the website of Xiangyin Gu, an artist based in London. It works like a computer from 1998: the work is kept in folders and programs on a desktop. You don’t need to know Windows to use it. Everything opens with the mouse, a finger or the keyboard.

The quickest ways in:

  • Projects: every project, as a folder.
  • The House: the same work, kept in the rooms of a house.
  • About.doc and Contact.
topics.htmlZh:
这是常驻伦敦的艺术家 Xiangyin Gu 的网站。它像一台1998年的电脑：作品存放在桌面上的文件夹和程序里。你不需要懂 Windows 也能使用它。一切都可以用鼠标、手指或键盘打开。

最快的入口：

  • 作品：每件作品都是一个文件夹。
  • 房子：同样的作品，存放在一座房子的房间里。
  • 关于.doc 和 联系。

topics.title: The desktop, Start menu and taskbar
topics.titleZh: 桌面、“开始”菜单和任务栏
topics.html:
The icons on the left of the screen are the desktop. Double-click an icon to open it. On a phone or tablet, tap it once.

The grey bar along the bottom is the taskbar. Click Start for a menu of everything on the site: Programs (each project, the House, About, Contact), recently opened Documents, Settings, Find, Help, Run and Shut Down.

Each open window has a button on the taskbar. Click a button to bring its window to the front; click it again to hide (minimise) the window. Rest the pointer on the clock to see the date. The speaker next to it turns sounds on and off.

Start → Find looks for a project, a room, a page or a Help topic by name. Start → Run opens something when you know its name: type hanabi, house or about and press Enter.

To tidy the desktop, drag icons where you like, or right-click it and choose Arrange Icons. Icons you delete go to the Recycle Bin; open it to put them back.
topics.htmlZh:
屏幕左边的图标就是桌面。双击一个图标即可打开它。在手机或平板电脑上，轻点一下就行。

屏幕底部的灰色长条是任务栏。单击开始会弹出一个菜单，里面有网站上的一切：程序（每件作品、房子、关于、联系）、最近打开的文档、设置、查找、帮助、运行和关闭系统。

每个打开的窗口在任务栏上都有一个按钮。单击按钮可以把它的窗口放到最前面；再单击一次就把窗口隐藏起来（最小化）。把指针停在时钟上可以看到日期。时钟旁边的喇叭可以打开或关闭声音。

开始 → 查找按名称查找作品、房间、网页或帮助主题。开始 → 运行在你知道名称时直接打开它：键入 花火、房子 或 关于，然后按 Enter 键。

要整理桌面，可以把图标拖到你喜欢的地方，或者右击桌面并选择排列图标。删除的图标会进入回收站；打开回收站就能把它们放回去。

topics.title: Using the mouse
topics.html:
• Click an icon to select it. Double-click to open it.
  • Right-click almost anything (the desktop, an icon, a window’s title bar, a photograph, a link) for a menu of what you can do with it. On a touch screen, press and hold instead, except on a photograph.
  • Drag a window by its title bar to move it, or drag its edges to resize it. Drag icons to arrange the desktop.
  • Drag across an empty part of the desktop to select several icons at once.
  • The photographs and drawings are protected by copyright: they can’t be saved or dragged out. What you draw in Paint is yours to keep.

The pointer changes as it did in 1998: an hourglass while something opens, a hand over links. Pointer trails (faint ghost pointers that follow the mouse) are off to begin with; you can switch them on in Control Panel → Mouse.
topics.htmlZh:
• 单击图标可以选定它。双击可以打开它。
  • 几乎所有东西（桌面、图标、窗口的标题栏、照片、链接）都可以右击，会弹出一个菜单，列出你可以对它做的事。在触摸屏上，改为按住不放（照片除外）。
  • 按住窗口的标题栏拖动可以移动窗口，拖动它的边框可以调整大小。拖动图标可以整理桌面。
  • 在桌面的空白处拖出一个方框，可以一次选定多个图标。
  • 网站上的照片和图画受版权保护，不能保存，也不能拖出来。你在“画图”里画的画归你所有。

指针会像1998年那样变化：打开东西时变成沙漏，移到链接上时变成一只手。指针轨迹（跟着鼠标的一串淡淡的指针）一开始是关闭的；你可以在“控制面板 → 鼠标”中打开它。

topics.title: Using the keyboard
topics.html:
Tab, Shift+TabMove between icons, buttons and links
EnterOpen the selected icon or link
Arrow keysMove between desktop icons and menu items; move around the house map
EscClose a menu or a dialog box
Shift+F10 or the Menu keyThe right-click menu for the selected thing
F1This Help (if your browser allows it). In a dialog box, it explains the setting you are on.
F3Find, on the desktop and in folders
BackspaceUp one level, in folders and the House
DeleteSend the selected desktop icon to the Recycle Bin
Ctrl+EscOpen the Start menu (if your computer allows it)
Alt+F4Close the active window (if your browser allows it)

Some shortcuts belong to your own computer or browser (for example Alt+Tab or Ctrl+W); those still do what they normally do.
topics.htmlZh:
Tab、Shift+Tab在图标、按钮和链接之间移动
Enter打开选定的图标或链接
方向键在桌面图标和菜单项之间移动；在房子的地图上移动
Esc关闭菜单或对话框
Shift+F10 或菜单键选定项目的右键菜单
F1打开这个帮助（如果你的浏览器允许）。在对话框中，它会解释你所在的设置。
F3查找，在桌面上和文件夹中都可以用
Backspace在文件夹和房子中向上一级
Delete把选定的桌面图标放入回收站
Ctrl+Esc打开“开始”菜单（如果你的电脑允许）
Alt+F4关闭当前窗口（如果你的浏览器允许）

有些快捷键属于你自己的电脑或浏览器（例如 Alt+Tab 或 Ctrl+W）；它们仍然照常工作。

topics.title: Windows
topics.html:
Every page opens in a window. The three buttons at the top right minimise, maximise (fill the screen) and close it. Double-click the title bar to maximise it or put it back. Windows can overlap: click one to bring it to the front.

Folders and the House have Back, Forward and Up buttons, and an Address bar you can type into, for example C:\xiangyin\image or /house. Your browser’s own Back button works too, and the browser’s address always shows the window in front, so you can share it or bookmark it.

If overlapping windows get in the way, choose Always maximize windows in Control Panel → Display: every window then fills the screen, like an ordinary website.
topics.htmlZh:
每个网页都在一个窗口中打开。右上角的三个按钮分别用来最小化、最大化（铺满屏幕）和关闭窗口。双击标题栏可以最大化窗口，或者把它还原。窗口可以互相重叠：单击一个窗口就能把它放到最前面。

文件夹和房子有后退、前进和向上按钮，还有一个可以键入的地址栏，例如 C:\xiangyin\image 或 /house。浏览器自己的“后退”按钮也能用；浏览器的地址栏总是显示最前面的窗口，所以你可以分享它，或者把它加入书签。

如果重叠的窗口碍事，可以在“控制面板 → 显示”中选择总是最大化窗口：这样每个窗口都会铺满屏幕，就像普通的网站一样。

topics.title: Looking at the work
topics.html:
The Projects folder holds every project. Choose a view: Thumbnails, List or Details. In Details, click a column heading to sort. Select a project to read about it on the left of the window; double-click to open it.

In a project, click a photograph to see it in the Image Viewer, where you can zoom in and step through the photographs. All projects on one page shows everything in one long page.
topics.htmlZh:
作品文件夹里存放着每一件作品。选择一种查看方式：缩略图、列表或详细资料。在“详细资料”中，单击列标题可以排序。选定一件作品，窗口左边会显示关于它的介绍；双击即可打开它。

在作品中，单击一张照片就会在图像查看器中看到它，在那里你可以放大，也可以一张一张地浏览照片。全部作品在一页把所有作品放在一个长长的页面里。

topics.title: Exploring the House
topics.html:
The site is also a house, drawn from the plans of the 2008 renovation of the family house. Its front, the south façade, has a door and windows you can click.

Inside, the floorplan works like a map: drag to move, scroll (or pinch) to zoom, and change floors with the buttons R, A, 2 and 1 (roof, attic, first floor, ground floor). Type in Search this house to find a room or a project. Tick Blueprint to see the original drawings.

Click a room to open it beside the plan. Every room has a chapter number, an inventory and a table of constraints. Some rooms have furniture with drawers: click a drawer to open it, then an object inside to read it.

One room has no door. It can’t be entered.
topics.htmlZh:
这个网站也是一座房子，取自家宅2008年翻修时的图纸。它的正面，也就是南立面，有一扇门和几扇窗户，都可以单击。

走进去，平面图就像一张地图：拖动以移动，滚动（或双指缩放）以放大缩小，用 R、A、2 和 1 按钮切换楼层（屋顶、阁楼层、二层、一层）。在搜索这座房子中键入文字，可以找到一个房间或一件作品。勾选蓝图可以看到原始图纸。

单击一个房间，它会在平面图旁边打开。每个房间都有一个章节号、一份清单和一张约束表。有些房间里有带抽屉的家具：单击抽屉打开它，再单击里面的物件来阅读。

有一个房间没有门。它无法进入。

topics.title: The rules of the house
topics.html:
The order of the rooms is set by a rule, after Georges Perec’s Life A User’s Manual: a knight moves across the house’s 5 × 5 structural grid, and the rooms are numbered in the order it first lands in them. Lists of sources, times and hidden things are dealt over the grid by Latin squares, and each room shows which of them it fulfils.

The Rules of the house draw the knight’s path and the order it gives the rooms, floor by floor, with a table of what each move opens.

Read the Rules of the house, the Index, the Chronology and the Checklist of the chapters.
topics.htmlZh:
房间的顺序由一条规则决定，仿照乔治·佩雷克的《人生拼图版》：一个骑士（国际象棋里的马）在房子 5 × 5 的结构网格上移动，房间按它第一次落入的先后编号。来源、时间和隐藏之物的清单用拉丁方分配到网格上，每个房间都标明它满足了其中哪些。

《房子的规则》画出了骑士的路线，以及它逐层给房间排出的顺序，并附有一张表，列出每一步开启了哪些章节。

请阅读房子的规则、索引、年表和章节清单。

topics.title: Getting in touch
topics.html: Open Contact to write a message: fill in your name, your email address, a subject and the message, then click Send. You can also follow the work on Instagram. Or open Paint and send a drawing instead: see Drawing something for the artist.
topics.htmlZh: 打开联系来写一条消息：填写你的名字、电子邮箱地址、主题和内容，然后单击发送。你也可以在 Instagram 上关注这些作品。或者打开画图，改为发送一幅画：请参阅给艺术家画一幅画。

topics.title: Drawing something for the artist (Paint)
topics.titleZh: 给艺术家画一幅画（画图）
topics.html:
Open Paint (on the desktop, or Start ▸ Programs ▸ Accessories) to draw something for Xiangyin and send it to him.

Drawing. Pick a tool on the left (at the bottom on a phone) and a colour from the colour box, then draw with a mouse, a finger or a pen. The right mouse button paints in the background colour; so does pressing and holding a colour on a touch screen. With a pen, press harder for a wider brush, and turn the pen over to rub out. On a touch screen, pinch with two fingers to zoom and drag with two fingers to move around. Undo takes back what you did, step by step.

Sending. Click Send to Xiangyin in the toolbar (or File ▸ Send). Add your name, a note and your email address if you like. All three are optional; leave an email address if you’d like a reply. Then click Send.

Where it goes. The picture (a PNG file), and whatever you filled in, go by email to Xiangyin’s inbox, through this website’s server. Nothing else is sent. It isn’t posted on the website or shown to anyone else, and the website keeps no copy. An anti-spam check by Cloudflare runs first.

Keeping it. While you draw, the picture is kept in this browser only, so closing Paint doesn’t lose it; File ▸ New starts again. File ▸ Save keeps a copy on your device. File ▸ Open, pasting, or dropping a picture on the window lets you draw on a picture you made somewhere else.

Ctrl+Z, Ctrl+YUndo, redo
B P A E F IBrush, pencil, airbrush, eraser, fill, pick colour
T L R O S ZText, line, rectangle, ellipse, select, magnifier
ShiftStraight lines at exact angles, squares and circles
XSwap the foreground and background colours
+ - 0Zoom in, zoom out, back to 100%
Ctrl+C, Ctrl+VCopy the selection (or the whole picture), paste a picture
Ctrl+EnterSend to Xiangyin
topics.htmlZh:
打开画图（在桌面上，或“开始 ▸ 程序 ▸ 附件”），给 Xiangyin 画点什么，然后发给他。

作画。在左边（手机上在下方）选一个工具，在颜料盒里选一种颜色，然后用鼠标、手指或手写笔作画。鼠标右键用背景色作画；在触摸屏上长按一种颜色也会把它设为背景色。用手写笔时，用力越大，刷子越粗；把笔倒过来就能擦除。在触摸屏上，用两根手指捏合可以缩放，用两根手指拖动可以移动画面。撤消可以一步一步退回你做过的操作。

发送。单击工具栏里的发给 Xiangyin（或“文件 ▸ 发送”）。如果愿意，可以写上你的名字、一段附言和你的电子邮箱地址。三项都可以不填；想收到回复的话，就留下电子邮箱地址。然后单击发送。

它去哪里。这幅画（PNG 文件）和你填写的内容，会通过这个网站的服务器，以电子邮件送到 Xiangyin 的邮箱。不会发送别的内容。它不会发布在网站上，也不会给别人看，网站也不保留副本。发送前会先进行 Cloudflare 的反垃圾验证。

保存。作画时，这幅画只保存在这个浏览器里，所以关闭“画图”也不会丢失；“文件 ▸ 新建”可以重新开始。“文件 ▸ 保存”可以在你的设备上保留一份。用“文件 ▸ 打开”、粘贴，或者把图片拖到窗口上，就可以在别处画好的图片上接着画。

Ctrl+Z、Ctrl+Y撤消、重做
B P A E F I刷子、铅笔、喷枪、橡皮、填充、取色
T L R O S Z文字、直线、矩形、椭圆、选定、放大镜
Shift画准确角度的直线、正方形和圆
X交换前景色和背景色
+ - 0放大、缩小、回到 100%
Ctrl+C、Ctrl+V复制选定内容（或整幅画）、粘贴图片
Ctrl+Enter发给 Xiangyin

topics.title: Field Guide
topics.html:
Field Guide opens guides to cities and festivals: a map of places worth seeing, with their opening days, routes and day-by-day notes. Open it from the desktop, or Start ▸ Programs ▸ Field Guide: it goes straight to the Enter Network Password box (or to the guide itself, once this browser has saved the password). When there is more than one guide, choose yours in that box: the tabs at the top ask what you would like to see (places to eat, exhibitions or photography), and the Guide box lists the guides of that kind. A guide can also be opened straight from a link someone sent you.

Places to eat. In a guide to restaurants, the Category, Price and Cuisine boxes narrow the list. Prices go from € (under €25 a head) to €€€€ (over €100), for food without drinks; ★ marks Michelin stars, and Bib a Bib Gourmand. Sort by can put the cheapest first. Opening hours change, so check before you go.

The password. Each guide asks for a password before it opens. You get it from the person who shared the guide with you; this help file can’t give it out. Type it in the Enter Network Password box and click OK. With Save this password ticked, this browser remembers it, so the guide opens straight away next time.

Different passwords, different detail. A guide can be shared with more than one group of people, each with its own password, and each group may see a different amount of detail. The status bar shows which you are logged on as. To use another password, choose File ▸ Log Off… in the guide’s window: this device forgets the password, and the box comes back.

Using it. Click a pin on the map, or a name in the list, to see the details. The day filter shows what is open on the day you choose; opening days are as published, not a live status, so check before a long trip. Routes link to a maps service for directions.

Moving the map. Drag it to move it, and scroll or pinch to zoom. Double-click to zoom in; hold down Shift as you double-click to zoom out. The buttons on the map zoom too, and show the whole map again.

Sorting the places. The Places list has a Sort by box above it. Recommended (the default) lists the A places first, then B and then C, each in number order. Name sorts by name, and Area follows the guide’s own order of areas. Open that day first needs a day chosen in the When box, and Nearest first needs Where am I?, below. Once another order is in use, a Default button appears: click it to go back to Recommended. View ▸ Sort By has the same orders. Sorting only changes the order inside each group of the list: reference points, places closed that day and official entries each stay together. The order you pick is remembered on this device, except Nearest first.

On a phone. The guide fills the screen. A row of buttons switches between the map, the list, routes, days and information; tapping a pin brings up its details from the bottom of the screen. On the map, the gestures are those of a maps app: drag with one finger to move it (a flick sends it gliding on), and pinch with two fingers to zoom. Double-tap to zoom in. Or double-tap and keep your finger down, then slide it down to zoom in or up to zoom out. Tap with two fingers to zoom out.

Held sideways. The guide fills the whole screen, as Internet Explorer’s Full Screen did. The taskbar steps aside: tap the window’s Minimize button to get it and the desktop back. The window’s buttons and the 中文/EN switch are at the right end of the menu bar, next to today’s note (tap the note to see the days), and the buttons for the map, the list and the rest stand down the left.

Your location. Where am I? asks your browser for your location only when you press it. The guide then follows you on the map: a red dot shows where you are, with a ring that beats out from it, and a Live location chip with a Stop button stays on the map. Click Live location to bring the map back to you. Pressing the Where am I? button again, pressing Stop, or choosing View ▸ Stop Showing My Location turns it off. A refresh, a log off or closing the window turns it off too, so it is off again after a refresh. Your position stays on your device. If your browser refuses, the guide says how to allow it. “Today” is worked out from the guide’s own time zone, not from where you are.

Suggesting a place. Know a place or a show that belongs in a guide, perhaps your own? Choose File ▸ Suggest a Place…, or Suggest on the toolbar, and the wizard asks what it is, when and where, for a link and, if you like, a picture. Your name and email are optional: they go only to the guide’s author and are deleted 90 days after the guide ends. Every suggestion is read before anything is added, so it may take a while to appear, or not appear at all.
topics.htmlZh:
导览用来打开城市和活动的导览：一张标出值得一看的地方的地图，附有开放日期、路线和每天的安排。从桌面打开它，或者单击“开始 ▸ 程序 ▸ 导览”，就会直接出现导览的密码对话框（如果这个浏览器已经保存了密码，就直接打开导览）。如果有不止一份导览，就在这个对话框里选择你的那一份：上方的选项卡先问你想看什么（吃饭的地方、看展览还是看摄影），导览框里列出这一类的导览。别人发给你的链接，也可以直接打开一份导览。

吃饭的地方。在餐厅导览里，类别、价位和菜系框可以缩小列表。价位从 €（人均 €25 以下）到 €€€€（€100 以上），只算餐费，不含酒水；★ 表示米其林星级，必比登表示必比登推介。排序方式可以把便宜的排在前面。营业时间会变，出发前请先确认。

密码。每份导览打开前都要输入密码。密码由把导览分享给你的人提供；这个帮助文件不能告诉你。在输入网络密码对话框里输入密码，然后单击确定。勾选保存密码的选项后，这个浏览器会记住它，下次就能直接打开导览。

不同的密码，不同的内容。一份导览可以分享给不止一群人，每群人有自己的密码，看到的详细程度也可能不同。状态栏会显示你是以哪种身份登录的。要换一个密码，在导览窗口里选择“文件 ▸ 注销…”：这台设备会忘掉密码，密码对话框会重新出现。

使用。单击地图上的图钉，或者列表里的名称，就能看到详细信息。日期筛选会显示你所选那一天开放的地方；开放日期按公布的信息列出，并不是实时状态，出远门前请先确认。路线可以链接到地图服务查看怎么走。

移动地图。拖动地图可以移动它，滚动鼠标滚轮或捏合可以缩放。双击放大；按住 Shift 键双击则缩小。地图上的按钮也能缩放，还能重新显示全图。

地点的排序。地点列表上方有一个排序方式框。推荐（默认）先列 A 级地点，再列 B 级和 C 级，每级按编号排。名称按名称排，区域按导览里片区的顺序排。当天开放的优先要先在上方的日期框里选定一天；离我最近要先按下我在哪里？（见下文）。选了别的排序后，会出现一个默认按钮，单击它就回到“推荐”。查看 ▸ 排序方式菜单里有同样的几种排序。排序只调整列表中每一组之内的次序：参考点、当天闭馆的地点和官方条目各自仍是一组。你选的排序会记在这台设备上，“离我最近”除外。

在手机上。导览会占满整个屏幕。用一排按钮在地图、列表、路线、日期和信息之间切换；轻点一个图钉，它的详细信息会从屏幕底部升起。地图上的手势和地图应用一样：用一根手指拖动可以移动地图（快速一划，地图会继续滑行），用两根手指捏合可以缩放。轻点两下放大。也可以轻点两下后按住不放，向下滑动放大，向上滑动缩小。用两根手指同时轻点一下则缩小。

横过来拿。导览会铺满整个屏幕，就像 Internet Explorer 的“全屏”。任务栏会让开：轻点窗口的最小化按钮，任务栏和桌面就会回来。窗口按钮和中文/EN 切换在菜单栏右端，旁边是今天的提示（轻点提示可以查看日期）；地图、列表等按钮竖着排在左边。

你的位置。只有在你按下我在哪里？时，浏览器才会询问你的位置。之后导览会在地图上跟随你：红色的圆点标出你所在的地方，圆点周围的圆环会一下一下地向外扩大；地图上还会出现一个实时位置的小标签，旁边有停止按钮。单击实时位置，地图就回到你身边。再按一次我在哪里？按钮、单击停止，或者选择查看 ▸ 不再显示我的位置，都会关掉它。刷新页面、注销或关闭窗口也会关掉它，所以刷新之后它是关着的。你的位置只留在你的设备上。如果浏览器不允许，导览会告诉你怎样允许。“今天”按导览自己的时区计算，而不是按你所在的地方。

推荐地点。知道一个应该放进导览的地点或展览，也许是你自己的？选择文件 ▸ 推荐地点…，或工具栏上的推荐，向导会问你它是什么、时间和地点，请你给一个链接，愿意的话再附一张图片。名字和电子邮箱可以不填：它们只交给导览的作者，导览结束 90 天后删除。每条推荐都会先有人看过才会收录，所以可能要过一段时间才出现，也可能不会收录。

topics.title: Changing the settings
topics.html:
Open Start → Settings → Control Panel.

  • Display: wallpaper (including some of the artist’s photographs), screen saver, colour scheme (High Contrast is easier to read), and effects such as dragging whole windows.
  • Mouse: pointer trails, double-click speed and larger pointers.
  • Sounds: turn sounds on or off and set the volume.
  • Folder Options: open icons with a single click instead of a double-click.

Not sure what a setting does? Click the ? at the top right of the dialog box, then click the setting: a yellow note explains it. (Or press F1 while it has the focus.)

What this computer remembers. Your settings; where you put the icons and the windows (each program opens where you left it, at the same size, maximised or not, with the same toolbars); whether to Show this screen each time Xiangyin 98 starts; and a message you haven’t sent yet, until you close the tab. Reload the page and the desktop comes back as it was: the same windows, in the same order, scrolled to the same place. All of it is kept in this browser only.
topics.htmlZh:
打开开始 → 设置 → 控制面板。

  • 显示：墙纸（包括艺术家的一些照片）、屏幕保护程序、配色方案（高对比白色更容易阅读），以及拖动时显示整个窗口之类的效果。
  • 鼠标：指针轨迹、双击速度和更大的指针。
  • 声音：打开或关闭声音，设置音量。
  • 文件夹选项：单击打开图标，而不是双击。

不确定某个设置是做什么的？单击对话框右上角的 ?，再单击那个设置：一张黄色的便笺会解释它。（或者在它获得焦点时按 F1。）

这台电脑记得什么。你的设置；你把图标和窗口放在哪里（每个程序都在你上次离开的地方打开，大小一样，是否最大化、工具栏也一样）；是否“每次启动 Xiangyin 98 时显示此屏幕”；还有一条还没发送的消息，直到你关闭这个标签页。刷新页面，桌面会恢复原样：同样的窗口，同样的前后顺序，滚动到同样的位置。这些都只保存在这个浏览器里。

topics.title: Cookies
topics.html:
Xiangyin 98 can keep a few things in this browser. None of them is used to track you. The first time you visit, a box asks what it may keep; to change your answer later, choose Start → Settings → Cookies.

  • Allow All keeps everything: the two cookies below, this tab’s memory, and your lasting preferences (settings, where you put icons and windows, the Recycle Bin, Documents, what you typed in Run, Paint’s tools and picture, Field Guide’s heat map, labels and sorting, the language).
  • Necessary Only keeps the two cookies and this tab’s memory. Field Guide’s cookie remembers that you typed a guide’s password: without it, you can’t open a guide. The log-on cookie keeps you logged on: without it, the computer starts up again each time you open or reload the site. This tab’s memory brings back your windows, a message or suggestion you haven’t sent and your place in a guide when you reload, until you close the tab.
  • None keeps nothing but your answer.

When something needs a cookie you haven’t allowed, such as logging on to a guide, a yellow Information Bar at the top of the screen asks for it. Click Allow to go ahead, or × to leave it.

A stricter choice at once removes what it doesn’t keep. It doesn’t log you out of a guide: in the guide, choose File ▸ Log Off….
topics.htmlZh:
Xiangyin 98 可以在这个浏览器里保存一些东西，但不会用它们跟踪你。第一次访问时，会有一个对话框问你允许保存什么；以后要更改，请选择开始 → 设置 → Cookie。

  • 全部允许保存所有内容：下面说的两个 Cookie、这个标签页的记忆，以及长期保存的偏好（设置、图标和窗口的位置、回收站、文档、在“运行”里键入过的内容、“画图”的工具和图画、导览的热图、标签和排序方式、语言）。
  • 仅必要只保存两个 Cookie 和这个标签页的记忆。导览的 Cookie 记住你已经键入过导览的密码：没有它，就无法打开导览。登录的 Cookie 让你保持登录：没有它，每次打开或刷新网站，计算机都会重新启动。这个标签页的记忆让你刷新后找回窗口、还没发送的消息或推荐和你在导览里的位置，直到你关闭这个标签页。
  • 全部拒绝除了你的回答，什么也不保存。

当某项功能需要你还没允许的 Cookie 时（比如登录一份导览），屏幕顶部会出现一条黄色的信息栏来询问。单击允许继续，或者单击 × 不用它。

改为更严格的选择时，它不保存的东西会立刻删除。但这不会让你退出导览：请在导览里选择“文件 ▸ 注销…”。

topics.title: Starting, logging off and shutting down
topics.html:
The first time you visit in a browser session, Xiangyin 98 starts up and asks you to log on. There’s no account: everyone logs on as Guest, with no password. Press OK (Cancel works too). Click or press any key to skip the start-up screen.

Start → Log Off shows the log-on box again. Start → Shut Down lets you shut the computer down (click to start again), restart it, or put it on stand-by.
topics.htmlZh:
在一次浏览器会话中第一次访问时，Xiangyin 98 会启动并请你登录。这里没有帐户：每个人都以 Guest 身份登录，不需要密码。按确定即可（按取消也可以）。单击或按任意键可以跳过启动画面。

开始 → 注销会再次显示登录框。开始 → 关闭系统可以关闭计算机（单击即可重新开始）、重新启动，或者让它待机。

topics.title: Troubleshooting
topics.html:
I can’t hear anything.
Click the speaker next to the clock and untick Mute. On an iPhone, also check the silent switch.
I don’t like the pointer trails or the animations.
Pointer trails are off unless you switched them on; to switch them off again: Control Panel → Mouse → untick Show pointer trails. If your device is set to reduce motion, there are no trails and windows open without animation.
The windows are too small, or overlap.
Maximise the window (the middle button at the top right), or choose Always maximize windows in Control Panel → Display.
A page looks wrong.
Click Refresh in the window, or reload the page in your browser.
I’d like the browser’s own right-click menu.
Hold Shift while you right-click. Not on a photograph or a drawing, though: those can’t be saved.
I can’t save a photograph.
The photographs and drawings are protected by copyright, so they can’t be saved. To share one, send its page instead: right-click the page (not the photograph) and choose Create Shortcut to copy the page’s address.
An icon has gone from the desktop.
Open the Recycle Bin, select the icon and click Restore. If the bin was emptied, open Control Panel → Display → Effects and click Restore Default Desktop.
The screen went dark, or photographs filled it.
That’s the screen saver. Move the mouse or press a key. To change or switch it off: Control Panel → Display → Screen Saver.
The colours are hard to read.
Control Panel → Display → Appearance → High Contrast White. Larger pointers are in Control Panel → Mouse.
The page is zoomed in on my phone.
Pinch with two fingers to zoom back out. Only pinching zooms: tapping twice doesn’t, and nor does typing in a box.
topics.htmlZh:
我听不到任何声音。
单击时钟旁边的喇叭，取消勾选静音。在 iPhone 上，还要检查静音开关。
我不喜欢指针轨迹或动画。
指针轨迹默认是关闭的。如果你打开过它，可以这样关掉：控制面板 → 鼠标 → 取消勾选显示指针轨迹。如果你的设备设置了减少动态效果，就不会有轨迹，窗口打开时也不会有动画。
窗口太小，或者互相重叠。
最大化窗口（右上角中间的按钮），或者在“控制面板 → 显示”中选择总是最大化窗口。
网页显示不正常。
单击窗口中的刷新，或者在浏览器中重新加载网页。
我想用浏览器自己的右键菜单。
右击时按住 Shift 键。但照片和图画上不行：它们不能保存。
我保存不了照片。
网站上的照片和图画受版权保护，不能保存。要分享，可以改为发送它所在的页面：右击页面（不是照片），选择创建快捷方式，就会复制这个页面的地址。
桌面上的一个图标不见了。
打开回收站，选定那个图标，然后单击还原。如果回收站已经清空，请打开“控制面板 → 显示 → 效果”，然后单击还原默认桌面。
屏幕变黑了，或者满屏都是照片。
那是屏幕保护程序。移动鼠标或按一个键即可。要更改或关闭它：控制面板 → 显示 → 屏幕保护程序。
颜色看不清楚。
控制面板 → 显示 → 外观 → 高对比白色。更大的指针在“控制面板 → 鼠标”中。
手机上的页面放大了。
用两根手指捏合，就能缩小回来。只有捏合会缩放：点两下不会，在文本框里打字也不会。
